Title: Is there a CLO manual available?
Content: The manual for CLO is available in English, Korean, Chinese, and Japanese. Please follow the respective link to access the manual.

Content: Payment for Individual subscriptions can be completed with several card brands, large global networks like Visa and Mastercard, and a mobile wallet. Please refer to the lists of supported payment methods below. Cards American Express China UnionPay (CUP) Discover &amp Diners Japan Credit Bureau (JCB) Mastercard Visa Wallets Apple Pay Google Pay Alipay For the payment for Enterprise, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us.

Title: Can I import/export OBJ, FBX, Alembic files?
Content: All OBJ, FBX, and Alembic files can be imported or exported to CLO. For further information on CLO's compatibility, please refer to the manual, Compatible File Format.

Title: What kind of 3D formats can be imported/exported to and from CLO?
Content: Please refer to the manual, Compatible File Format, to find the list of compatible 3D files.

Title: How can I check my computer specification?
Content: To check your computer specification, please follow the guideline below: Press the Windows + R keys on your keyboard simultaneously, and type "dxdiag" without the quotes. Press the Enter key or click the 'OK' button. Choose 'Save All Information' at the bottom of the window. Save it as a text file.

Title: Does any universities offer courses in CLO?
Content: We partner with various academic institutions worldwide. Please refer to our Clients page for more information.

Title: I get an error message saying, "H0007 Sentinel HSAP not found." How should I solve the problem?
Content: This issue often occurs when the program cannot find the dongle key for authentication. Please refer to the manual to learn how to solve the issue in detail.

Title: Do I need to configure my firewall to use CLO?
Content: As long as you are connected to an internet, you can use CLO without configuring firewall. If you are using CLO for Enterprise and need to configure firewall due to company protocols, please contact us.

Title: Do I need to know 3D modeling in order to use CLO?
Content: No, CLO does not require any 3D modeling skills or any 3D software experience. However, prior experience with 3D software may increase your learning speed.

Title: Are there CLO offices located nearby?
Content: CLO is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with additional offices in Munich, Paris, São Paulo, New York, Los Angeles, Madrid, Bengaluru, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Hong Kong. We also have a network of re-sellers in select countries. To learn more, please refer to our About CLO page.

Title: Is 4K supported by CLO?
Content: Yes, 4K is supported by CLO from its ver4.0.0.

Title: Does CLO offer a Linux version?
Content: Unfortunately, CLO does not offer a Linux version and currently has no plan to develop one. If you find the Linux version of CLO is essential to your company, please post a request here. Our developers will review and rate the importance and priority for future new features.

Title: What is the difference between CLO and Marvelous Designer?
Content: Although the core technology behind the solutions are the same, Marvelous Designer is primarily used in the CG, animation, and gaming industries. CLO is a more robust solution geared towards the fashion and apparel industries with functions that can be applied to various stages of the garment design development process. The primary difference between the two solutions is that the import/export of DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM files in CLO, allows for production-ready patterns to be sent to your manufacturer.

Title: Review Mode: How to use the Review data which saved in version 6.1 be used in version 6.2?
Content: From version 6.2, the simulation results by size have been improved to be applied directly to the review mode. Therefore, the 3D status info for the Review saved in version 6.1 or lower version is not compatible, and you need to re-simulate for each size. See below video also.

Title: Although my hardware has more than 4 CPU Cores, CLO is not as fast as I expected.
Content: CLO's program speed increases with faster Core clock speed and more Cores. However, there is NO significant speed advancement when there are more than 4 Cores compared to the program speed ran with four Cores. Therefore, to be cost-effective, we recommend hardware with four Cores, each Core's speed being between 3.5 ~4.0 Ghz or faster.

Title: Can I use my license on multiple devices?
Content: Yes, you can install and use CLO software on another computer or device. However, you can't access CLO on multiple devices at the same time. It is required to deactivate your license in CLO software first before using it on another device. Please refer to the article: How can I deactivate my license? If you need to deactivate your license remotely, you will need to visit the CLO website for remote deactivation. Please refer to the following article: Deactivate CLO on the website. For CLO for Enterprise, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us. *CLO software provides only on Windows/ macOS, not on mobile or iPad. Please refer to the CLO System Requirements for more information on the device specification.

Title: Register Avatar Accessory(7.3)
Content: Objective Register an avatar accessory file or convert a pattern into an accessory. Location Main Menu Avatar Register Accessory Operation Open the CLO avatar file. Click the tool/menu indicated. Register Accessory window appears. After setting the options below, click the Save button. Menu Description Basic Accessory Type Select the type of the accessory.(Hair, Shoes, Earring, Glasses) Object Select the type of the object (file and pattern) to register. You can load and select objects in the 3D window and adjust their positions directly. File Select the path to the hair and shoe files to register. Scale/ Axis Conversion Change the size and axis of the loaded file and check it simulatenously. Pattern Select the pattern you want to convert to the accessory. However, the pattern to be converted must be created in advance before the accessory registration is proceeded. Note:After selecting the pattern to be converted to an accessory, you can also right-click the 3D pattern Convert to Avatar Accessory menu. Option Mirror Creation If you register shoes and earrings, it automatically creates the opposite object. Inverted relative to the central axis of the avatar. Thumbnail Auto Apply the thumbnail image automatically. Custom Apply the desired image as the thumbnail. Save File window appears. Set the file name and path. Saved as the Avatar Accessory File (ZACS).

Title: Linked Editing
Content: List of Contents Setting Edit Options and Properties Objective You can quickly edit multiple patterns together by linking different pattern outlines. Operation Setting Click the 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern (Z) tool. Click one of the two segments to be edited simultaneously, or select multiple segments simultaneously while holding down the Shift key on the keyboard, and Right-click Link Lines menu. Move the mouse cursor to click the opposite segment you want to edit simultaneously, or hold down the Shift key on your keyboard and click multiple segments. Linked editing is set to both selected segments. Note : If the pattern has already been sewn, you can connect it more easily by right-clicking on the sewing line with the 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing(B) tool clicking the Link Lines menu. Even if it is not sewing, we recommend sewing first and setting Link Lines if necessary. Edit Edit one side of the segment set for linked editing with 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern (Z) tool. Based on the edited segment, the opposite segment is edited in the same direction in a symmetrical direction. Options and Properties Click the 2D Toolbar Edit Link tool. Right-click on the segment set for linking and apply options as needed. Unlink Remove the linked editing. Flip Direction Set to be simultaneously edited in the same direction. Note: You can also apply it in the property editor by clicking on the linked editing segment. Add Sewing to Linking If there is no sewing line, a sewing line is added based on both lines set for linked editing.

Content: Yes, you can check and print out your invoice from the CLO website. To check your invoice, Go to your Billing page and click the "Billing Details" button. Click the "Invoice" button according to your subscription. Click the "Print" symbol to print out or download your invoice.

Change your card information and click the "Save" button. *The changed payment information will be reflected on your next subscription. *In case your license is not currently active, you can only update your payment method when you purchase a new license. *Alipay users cannot change the payment method and need to cancel and resubscribe with a new payment method. *If you have an issue regarding changing the payment method, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us.

Title: How can I update my billing information?
Content: To change your billing information, please follow the indicated guideline below. Updated billing information will be reflected on your next subscription renewal or re-subscription. Please login to your account and click the "Billing page". Click the "Update Billing Information" button and click the "Edit" button under Billing Information. *VAT number for withdrawing TAX is applicable for EU countries only.

Title: CLO runs very slowly when I edit 3D Garment with Particle Distance 5. What should I do?
Content: For all 3D garment simulation programs, its simulation speed varies depending on the number of meshes in a single file. More meshes there are, slower the speed is. On the other hand, less meshes there are, faster the speed is. When Patterns' Particle Distance is set to 5, the program naturally slows down due to increase of the number of meshes in a single file. Therefore, we STRONGLY insist you to increase the Particle Distance to 20 when editing 3D Garments and decrease it to 5 when the 3D Garment is fully completed. Then, simulate for about 1~2 minutes. Does CLO still run slowly though Patterns' Particle Distance is set to 20? This may happen when a Pattern is huge (e.g. flare skirt patterns,) because regardless of the Particle Distance value, bigger Patterns contain more meshes. Also, due to difference in their intrinsic character, the program speed may reduce when Patterns' mesh structure is set to Quadrangular. Please refer to Quadrangular/Triangular Mesh manual and configure mesh type as Quadrangular ONLY when needed. Moreover, program speed is also influenced by hardware specification. Please check out suggested specification here.
